policy.authorization: Specific implementation edits remain per-ID and evidence-bound. roundingEvidence.reason: Reparenting nine gaze children to new native warps introduces floating-point evaluation rounding. Limit is 1/4096 source pixel; checkpoint maximum was 1/8192.

policy.remeshReason: The five existing eye mesh IDs are individually identified in the hash-bound Core and editing evidence. Two new aperture masks are separately recorded. Every other original mesh stays exact except the explicitly listed parent-float IDs, whose 1/4096-source-pixel limit remains unchanged.
